scope: Checked local presence and byte counts for each named MP4, measured SRT, and measured lesson JSON. Captured SHA-256 for each upload JSON, SRT, and lesson JSON. MP4s were not rehashed; their recorded upload SHA-256 values are retained. For source alignment, compared measured lesson audio filenames with staged public-slim audio filenames when present.
selectionRule: Include visibility Public when status is published or undefined. Exclude Deleted, superseded-deleted, private and non-public records.

stagedAudioFilenameComparison.details: Comparison uses audio filenames only. A matching staged filename set is evidence of source alignment, not proof that a particular MP4 was rendered from that bundle.
